text:
alex (AE): Quick sync — Northstar Capital sent back the SIG and wants evidence for 120 questions by EOW. Can we triage?

maria (SE): I can own the access control and auth questions. I'll need current IAM roles + RBAC matrix.

olivia (security): I can do a pass on encryption, key mgmt, and incident response. @maria please tag me when you upload any logs.

kevin (sales-engineer): I'll pull backup/DR, deployment architecture, and third-party vendor list. Do we have a single zip of previous SIG artifacts?

alex (AE): We have the SOC2 report and certs but need per-question evidence. Upload expected artifacts to the secure bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/northstar/ (redwood-security-only).

devops-bot: Uploaded file northstar-SIG-evidence-2026.zip (2.3MB) to s3://redwood-evidence/northstar/ -- presigned links expire in 48h.

maria (SE): Downloaded the zip. It has: soc2_report.pdf, kms-rotation.md, network-diagram-v1.png, terraform-state-redacted.tf. I'll extract RBAC from terraform and build a CSV.

olivia (security): Need explicit artifact for KMS rotation: please include the rotation policy and last rotation dates. Sample snippet is fine.

kevin (sales-engineer): Adding rotation table to kms-rotation.md now. Also uploading vault-policy.json and a doc: key-ownership-matrix.xlsx

alex (AE): For question 45 (data residency) — Northstar needs an affirmation that no customer data is stored in EU region for this playground account. @charlie can you confirm expected prod region?

charlie (customer): Northstar's legal team expects explicit EU residency statement. They want the list of regions where logs and backups may exist.

olivia (security): I'll redact any account IDs, then assemble a region statement and a short dataflow diagram. Will also attach the logging retention policy.

maria (SE): Proposed task list (short):
- Access controls: maria (extract RBAC CSV)
- Encryption & KMS: olivia + kevin (artifacts + rotation table)
- Network & architecture: kevin (network diagram + VPC peering details)
- Compliance artifacts: alex (SOC2, ISO links)
- DR/Backups: kevin (RTO/RPO doc)

kevin (sales-engineer): ETA: I'll have network diagram v2 + RTO doc by tomorrow 4pm PT.

olivia (security): ETA: I'll produce the redacted region statement and KMS rotation summary by EOD tomorrow.

alex (AE): Thanks team. I'll collate into the SIG workbook and drop the per-question evidence map into the shared drive. One ask from Northstar: they want a named contact for follow-up technical questions. Can @maria or @kevin be the primary? :eyes: 

maria (SE): I can be primary for technical follow-ups during their evaluation window next week. :+1: 

devops-bot: New file uploaded: northstar-sig-question-map-176900.zip (1.1MB) to s3://redwood-evidence/northstar/ (restricted).

alex (AE): Perfect. I'll respond to Northstar with the plan and expected delivery times. I'll cc security.

charlie (customer): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you need any extra forms for procurement, ping me. :thumbsup: 

olivia (security): Quick note — when you assemble artifacts, include MD5 hashes for binary files and a short README describing redaction steps. That speeds vendor review.

maria (SE): Good call. I'll add README and include the RBAC CSV + sample terraform snippets.

alex (AE): Closing loop: I'll send the draft evidence packet to Northstar tomorrow AM and link the secure bucket. Thanks all. :rocket:
